mutations.label: RDA the adoption check is removed, so an adopting run is reported as a FAILED prediction again -- r46's false FALSIFIED returns. A false FALSIFIED is worse than a false N-A: it sends a reader after a defect that is not there.

RDB the N-A arm stops requiring an empty result, so a run that ADOPTED and nevertheless carries copy is reported as unexercised -- throwing away a working claim. Only the 'copy present on an adopting run' test refuses it.

RDC the needle becomes the TICKET ID instead of #1203nl's emitted sentence. A lane or an auditor grepping for the id puts the id in the log, so this would read a search as an adoption -- the same trap `SEED SHORTFALL` sprang 12 times.
mutations.find: _adopt_kz = re.search(r"design system was ADOPTED from '([^']+)'", logtext or "")

mutations.label: RDD CONTROL, expected CAUGHT: the verdict stops naming the donor run, so a reader cannot tell WHICH design system was adopted -- the log names it and #983 says to pass the actionable part through.
mutations.find: "from %s without spawning the design_analyst (#1202hj, announced by #1203nl) "
mutations.replace: "from another run without spawning the design_analyst (#1202hj) "
